profile_text.body:
SentinelOne is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NYSE: S, CIK 0001583708) that describes itself as offering an AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform. The company positions its platform as unifying endpoint, cloud, identity, and data protection, supported by what it calls a Security Data Lake. Its site states that the platform is built around autonomous security intelligence intended to detect and respond to threats at machine speed, and that it has been recognized in the inaugural IDC MarketScape for SIEM.

The company's primary tracked AI product is SentinelOne Purple AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. According to the site, Purple AI and agentic workflows handle triage, correlation, and routine incident response, with the stated aim of freeing analysts for higher-value work. The broader platform covers endpoint and identity protection delivered through a single lightweight agent, and the company says it can autonomously stop supply chain attacks, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse. The site also notes that the platform extends to protecting AI systems that businesses themselves rely on.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for SentinelOne.
